# Reset Password

Enter and confirm a new password behind a reset flow.

## Preview

[Open the exact pattern in the real BeeUI Web Showcase](/showcase/?surface=pattern&id=reset-password&embed=1). This is a Web runtime preview, not native-device evidence.

Each named state is directly addressable:

- [`default`](/showcase/?surface=pattern&id=reset-password&state=default&embed=1)
- [`loading`](/showcase/?surface=pattern&id=reset-password&state=loading&embed=1) The same source is available at [`apps/showcase/patterns/auth/screens/reset-password-screen.tsx`](https://github.com/beobungbu/BeeUI/blob/main/apps/showcase/patterns/auth/screens/reset-password-screen.tsx).

## Composition

Principal public BeeUI exports used by this screen: [`Button`](/docs/components/button/), [`Card`](/docs/components/card/), [`Field`](/docs/components/field/), [`PasswordInput`](/docs/components/password-input/), [`VStack`](/docs/components/stack/).

The pattern is a composition recipe rather than a new framework layer. Follow the linked component contracts for state, provider, platform and accessibility details.

## State and callback contract

The screen is controlled through `ResetPasswordScreenProps`. User intent crosses the application boundary through `onConfirmPasswordChange`, `onPasswordChange`, `onSubmit`; fetching, routing, persistence and side effects remain application-owned.

Common product states such as loading, success, empty, error, permission-like recovery, filtering/search/selection or pagination are represented only where the actual screen source exposes them. The pattern docs do not invent backend states that the fixture does not render.

## Responsive contract

This pattern follows BeeUI's [mobile-first responsive contract](/docs/responsive/): narrow-phone composition is the baseline; larger widths may reflow or promote navigation/layout according to BeeUI breakpoint tokens. Safe-area and scroll ownership stay explicit, and short-height/landscape/large-text constraints must be handled without viewport-level horizontal scrolling.

## Accessibility

The screen inherits the semantics, touch-target, focus/keyboard, RTL, large-text and reduced-motion contracts of its component composition. Use the [Accessibility guide](/docs/accessibility/) for evidence scope. A Web preview does not substitute for VoiceOver/TalkBack runtime evidence.

## Application ownership boundary

**Intentionally excluded:** Reset-token validation and the password mutation.

BeeUI does not take ownership of app routing, authentication/business rules, APIs/data fetching, persistence, form/state frameworks, chart frameworks or backend logic merely because a pattern visually composes those product concepts.

## Source ownership

Adapt the pattern by owning the screen source and, where useful, source-owning its BeeUI components through the repository-local Registry workflow. Before public CLI publication, use [CLI & source ownership](/docs/guides/cli-source-ownership/) from a BeeUI checkout rather than a public `npx` command.
